title: The Union Square Heist
tagline: A diamond heist. Three alibis. One is impossible.
briefing: Saturday, 9:00 PM. Someone opened the rear door of Ravenna Jewelers in Union Square with a staff code and walked out with $400,000 in diamonds. No forced entry. Three people had a reason to be near the store tonight, and every one of them has an alibi. One alibi is impossible. Use the map to prove which.

crime.summary: the robbery of Ravenna Jewelers in Union Square at 9:00 PM tonight
crime.label: Crime scene

suspects.name: Marco Vale
suspects.role: Former sales clerk, fired three weeks ago
suspects.bio: Worked at Ravenna Jewelers for two years until he was let go. Drives a grey sedan, plate RV-4127. Lives in Kestrel Tower, SoMa.
suspects.voice: Charming at first, then prickly and sarcastic. Short sentences. Calls the detective 'detective'. Bitter about being fired.
suspects.truth: You paid at Joe's Café in North Beach at 8:38 PM and left at 8:40. You drove down Stockton Street, parked behind Ravenna Jewelers at 8:55, and at 9:00 used your old staff door code (they never deactivated it) to get in. You took the diamond tray and left at 9:04, then drove down Market Street home to Kestrel Tower. The concierge logged you at 9:21. The diamonds are in a cereal box in your kitchen. You did it because they fired you with a week's notice and you owe money.
suspects.cover: You were at Joe's Café the whole evening, from about 8:00 until 9:10. Then you drove straight home to Kestrel Tower and were home by 9:15, watching the game on TV.
suspects.pressure: If the detective shows your times don't work (the drive is too long, or the concierge log says 9:21), do not confess. Adjust: say you must have left Joe's earlier, around 8:50, and got home around 9:20. If asked about your route, say you took Stockton and Market Street, the usual way, and didn't stop anywhere. Get irritated. Deny going near Ravenna Jewelers and say half the city drives a grey sedan.
suspects.stressHint: Hiding that he robbed the store. Pressure points: exact times he left Joe's and got home, the drive time, Stockton/Market Street, the traffic camera, his grey sedan, the door code, the concierge log. Small talk about being fired makes him bitter, not scared.
suspects.confession: Marco stares at the route on the map for a long time. "They gave me a week's notice after two years. And they never even changed the door code." He laughs, once. "Check the cereal box in my kitchen."

mock.alibi: I was at Joe's Café all evening, from about 8:00 until 9:10. Then I drove straight home, I was home by 9:15 watching the game.
mock.cornered: Okay, fine, maybe I left Joe's earlier. Around 8:50. I took Stockton and Market like always and got home around 9:20. I didn't stop anywhere, detective.
mock.evidence: Half this city drives a grey sedan, detective. That proves nothing.
deflect: I already told you. Joe's, then home.
Am I under arrest? Because this is starting to feel like harassment.
Ask Joe. He'll tell you I was there.

suspects.name: Lena Ortiz
suspects.role: Store manager, closed up at 8:00 PM
suspects.bio: Manager of Ravenna Jewelers for six years. Locked up tonight at 8:00 PM. Lives in Bernal Heights.
suspects.voice: Polite, anxious, over-explains, apologizes a lot.
suspects.truth: You closed the store at 8:00 PM and were in such a hurry for your movie that you forgot to set the vault alarm. You bought a ticket at the Rialto Cinema in the Mission at 8:24, watched the 8:30 show, went to the snack bar around 8:50 (back in your seat at 8:52), and stayed until it ended at 10:10. You drove home to Bernal Heights and got in around 10:20. You had nothing to do with the robbery, but you're terrified you'll be blamed for the alarm.
suspects.cover: You were at the Rialto Cinema for the 8:30 show. You got there around 8:25, stayed until it ended at 10:10, then drove home to Bernal Heights, arriving about 10:20. You say you set the alarm when you closed up at 8:00, like always.
suspects.pressure: If the detective pushes about the alarm, closing up, or the staff roster more than once, crack and admit you might not have set the vault alarm. Insist you never went near the store after 8:00.
suspects.stressHint: Innocent of the robbery but hiding that she forgot to set the vault alarm. Pressure points: the alarm, closing up, the staff roster. Questions about the movie are easy for her.
suspects.innocentReveal: Lena was back in her seat at the Rialto at 8:52 PM, 18 minutes from the store. She couldn't have been there at 9:00. Her only mistake: forgetting the vault alarm.

mock.alibi: I was at the Rialto Cinema, the 8:30 show. I got there around 8:25 and stayed until it ended at 10:10, then I drove home and got in about 10:20.
mock.cornered: I... okay. When I locked up at 8:00, I don't think I set the vault alarm. I was rushing to the movie. I'm so sorry. But I never went back there, I swear.
mock.evidence: That's me, yes. I was at the movie the whole time, I promise.
deflect: I'm sorry, I've told you everything I know.
I just went to see a movie, that's all.
Can I call someone? I'm really nervous.

suspects.name: Dez Okafor
suspects.role: Security guard, rostered to patrol the store
suspects.bio: Contract security guard. Tonight's roster had him patrolling Ravenna Jewelers from 8:30 to 10:00 PM. Also works shifts at a warehouse at Pier 70.
suspects.voice: Gruff, few words, ex-army. Gets defensive about money.
suspects.truth: You were rostered to patrol Ravenna Jewelers from 8:30 to 10:00 PM, but you skipped it to take a better-paying shift at the Pier 70 warehouse in Dogpatch. You badged in at gate 2 at 8:44, were at the loading bay at 8:56 (on camera), and did rounds there until 11:00. You had nothing to do with the robbery, but you're afraid of losing your job: your absence is why the store was unguarded.
suspects.cover: You were working at the Pier 70 warehouse: you badged in at 8:44 and did rounds until 11:00. Avoid mentioning that you were supposed to be at the jewelry store.
suspects.pressure: If the detective brings up the staff roster or asks why you weren't at the jewelry store, admit you skipped the store shift for the warehouse job. Insist you never left the warehouse.
suspects.stressHint: Innocent of the robbery but hiding that he skipped his store patrol for a warehouse shift. Pressure points: the roster, his patrol shift, money. Questions about the warehouse are easy.
suspects.innocentReveal: Dez was on warehouse camera at 8:56 PM, 16 minutes from the store. He skipped his patrol for extra cash, which was careless but not criminal.

mock.alibi: Pier 70 warehouse. Badged in at 8:44, did rounds till 11:00. Check the gate log.
mock.cornered: Fine. I was supposed to be on the jewelry store patrol tonight. Took the warehouse shift instead, it pays double. That's why nobody was there. But I didn't rob anybody.
mock.evidence: Yeah, that's me. Told you. I was at the warehouse.
deflect: Already told you where I was.
I've got nothing else to say.

evidence.title: Joe's Café receipt
evidence.detail: Card payment by Marco Vale: one espresso, one slice of pie. Timestamp 8:38 PM.

evidence.title: Market Street traffic camera
evidence.detail: 8:58 PM: a grey sedan near Union Square, heading toward Ravenna Jewelers. Plate partly visible: RV-41??

evidence.title: Kestrel Tower concierge log
evidence.detail: Resident M. Vale, apt 9C, entered the lobby at 9:21 PM.

evidence.title: Rear door keypad log
evidence.detail: Rear door opened with an old staff code at 9:00 PM. The code was never deactivated after a recent staff change.

evidence.title: Rialto Cinema ticket
evidence.detail: One adult ticket, 8:30 PM screening, bought at the box office at 8:24 PM by L. Ortiz.

evidence.title: Rialto usher statement
evidence.detail: "Ms. Ortiz came back from the snack bar at about 8:52 and sat through the rest of the film."

evidence.title: Pier 70 gate log
evidence.detail: Badge D. Okafor, gate 2, IN at 8:44 PM.

evidence.title: Warehouse CCTV still
evidence.detail: Dez Okafor at the Pier 70 loading bay, 8:56 PM.

evidence.title: Ravenna staff roster
evidence.detail: Security patrol tonight: D. Okafor, 8:30 to 10:00 PM. Vault alarm set by: L. Ortiz at close (8:00 PM), no confirmation recorded.

solution.explanation: Marco Vale. He said he was at Joe's Café until 9:10 and home by 9:15, but that drive takes 22 minutes, and the concierge logged him at 9:21. His real route ran down Stockton and Market Street, right past Ravenna Jewelers at 9:00, where a traffic camera caught his grey sedan.
solution.weakCase: You like Marco for it, but the DA wants proof. Catch Marco in a timeline the map says is impossible, then accuse.
